items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: My man Tony Bazley... wanted to make sure that I call you Wilbur. [INTERVIEWEE] Nat Adderley and Cannonball used to call me that... 'James Wilbur.'

ctx.x: My man Tony Bazley, he’s a drummer in New Orleans. He wanted to make sure that I call you Wilbur.
Nat Adderley and Cannonball used to call me that. They used to call me both my names, says, “James Wilbur.” That’s what they – they’re really getting familiar. Some people do that now.
That’s what the Bullet called you?
